meta.title: UOM Standardization: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify that UOM Standardization is refused or not offered.
Repeat UOM Standardization as a Tenant Admin and verify that the action is available.
Compare the two role outcomes in the same tenant and record any deliberate RBAC configuration.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify that UOM Standardization is refused or not offered.; Repeat UOM Standardization as a Tenant Admin and verify that the action is available.; Compare the two role outcomes in the same tenant and record any deliberate RBAC configuration.

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant-Admin user, test UOM Standardization against the master list, then repeat as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant and compare whether the action is refused or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch between these user roles or operate the UOM Standardization feature.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash or unrelated application error after the tester's role comparison.
